'''Zegundis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Lone Wolf" /> [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] [[Technician|mechanic]]<ref name="JCF" /> who worked at [[Paolo's Chop Shop]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. When Zegundis was a [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]], Paolo passed away and Zegundis eventually took up ownership of his shop, where she employed the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Ishtah]].<ref name="Lone Wolf" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The events of ''Lone Wolf: A Tale of Obi-Wan and Luke'' occur during those of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to 19 BBY.</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] sold the [[Belbullab-22 starfighter/Legends|Belbullab-22 starfighter]] [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']] to Zegundis while on his way to deliver the infant [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to the [[Lars family/Legends|Lars family]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Kenobi then used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Memory rub/Legends|erase]] Zegundis's memory of their interaction.<ref name="Lone Wolf" />
